title: Article 388 — Filling of casual vacancies in provisional Parliament and provisional Legislatures (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 388 provided for filling casual vacancies in the provisional Parliament and provisional State Legislatures. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
content.glance: Art 388 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Casual vacancies in provisional bodies — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 388?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
